stem:
Uma describes human digestion of complex food components such as carbohydrates, proteins and fats.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Digestion breaks complex food into simpler forms along the alimentary canal from mouth to anus.
Digestion builds complex food from simpler forms along the alimentary canal from anus to mouth.
Digestion happens only in the mouth; nothing further along the canal breaks food down.
Digestion is only the chewing of food; chemical breakdown is not part of digestion.

teacher.key_rationale: Human digestion is the breakdown of complex food into simpler forms along the alimentary canal from mouth to anus.
